t: The Darkness Pathway has powers related to the night and sleep. They gain strength during nighttime, can pacify and host souls, enter others' dreams, cast area-of-effect sleep spells, see in the dark, and suppress their enemies' moods and desires.

At High-Sequences, they can create domains from darkness, bring death to others by the horror and repose, create realistic dreams, shift a certain area under the state of secrecy, erase or hide things, bestow misfortune upon others, be an immortal within darkness, and become an embodiment of their corresponding authorities.
